values.note: Dry camping (electricity only) $37, 30-amp $40, 50-amp $43, each plus tax; a 10% 'Discount' rate is listed for each (the page does not say who qualifies). Extra adult $2 each; no charge for children. Weekly and monthly rates also posted (monthly sites $450, concrete $500). Tenting $27; small/large cabins $35/$45. Dump fee $10 for non-guests.

note: Private RV park on the Little Blackfoot River at Garrison, just off I-90/US-12. Grass sites with shade trees on a 20-acre park; the river borders the park, with fishing on site. Chapel with fellowship hall; two camping cabins. --Claude
summary: Operator site (all content in images; rates image dated Feb 2024): set fees $37 (dry camping, electricity only) to $43 (50-amp), plus tax; confirmed 50-amp full hookups, showers, laundry, dump, Good Sam Park; added 50 sites and WiFi; cleared the directory-derived military discount. The pages do not state pull-throughs, a season, booking method or max rig length. Base under the US$50 gate.
flags: Waterfront re-audit lead: entry says 'not waterfront', but the operator states 'the Little Blackfoot River bordering the edge of the park', 'River bordering the park' and 'Walk along the river & fishermen can test their skills' (Index.html, amenities.html).

Long-stay check: monthly sites ($450 / $500 concrete) and 'Whether you're here for the season' sit beside posted nightly and weekly rates, so nights are for sale to a passing traveller; noted, not a drop.
Website is an image-only 2019-era site; the rates image was updated 2024-02-06 (2024 rates). It may be stale for 2026.
